description: A long free-text answer with many details: the main complaint must lead and the key facts must survive the shortening.

answers.reason: Knee pain and stiffness for two months
answers.symptoms: I started running again in September and about two months ago my right knee began to hurt. At first it was only after runs, now it also hurts when I go down the stairs. In the morning the knee is stiff for about half an hour, then it loosens up. Last week it looked a bit swollen compared to the left one, but it is not hot or red. I have not had any injury or fall. I tried resting for one week, wearing a knee brace and using a cold pack, and it only helped a little. Walking on flat ground is fine. Squatting and kneeling are the worst. My father had knee problems when he was in his fifties. I would like to know if I can keep running and what I should avoid.
answers.medicines: Meloxicam 7.5 mg once a day, vitamin D
